releaseNotes: HWM DEV 0.2.5.15 pairs the current stable service 0.2.5.11 with tray 1.0.0.11. The tray fixes the long-idle first-open crash by reusing one WinForms ToolTip instead of creating new ToolTip objects during repeated background cloud-status refreshes. Existing first-show and tray reliability protections remain unchanged.
